# Masuku Adventure Safaris

> Curated African safari packages, Victoria Falls activities, and transfers. Based in Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe.

Masuku Adventure Safaris plans wildlife journeys across Zimbabwe, Botswana, Zambia, Tanzania, Kenya, Namibia, and South Africa. Travelers can browse packages, book activities, and request custom itineraries.

Site: https://masukusafaris.com
Email: bookings@masukusafaris.com
Phone: +263 78 285 6955
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/263782856955
Location: Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe
